mechanism_of_action: Not stated; the abstract notes reported anti-inflammatory and insulin-sensitizing effects.
primary_endpoint: Change in hepatic fat content and NAFLD progression after 6 months, assessed by liver biopsy.
efficacy_outcome: Compared with placebo, vitamin D significantly improved hepatic steatosis and lobular inflammation, but not hepatocyte ballooning or fibrosis. AST, ALT, TG, LDL, FBG, FBI, and HOMA-IR decreased, while vitamin D levels and HDL increased (P < 0.05).
